title: Both Aoide event streams in the mesh tab: the audit log and the daemon feed
operator_decision: 2026-10-07, the user chose 'Both streams': two flags, the audit log and the daemon feed, each defaulting to aoide's own path; the tail merges them, marked by source; perch-open.sh passes nothing extra; read-only.
why: Today the perch has one flag, --aoide-events, with no default, so in production the mesh tab's feed is empty. The runner also hands that same path to every aoide call as AOIDE_AUDIT_LOG, so pointing the flag at aoided's feed would make aoide append audit records INTO the daemon's feed. Two named files with aoide's own defaults fix both.
what:
Perch:
- Replace --aoide-events with two flags.
  - --aoide-audit-log <PATH>: absolute only. The default is the file aoide itself appends to under the runner's environment: <aoide-home>/log, where aoide-home is --aoide-home, else ~/.aoide. Check this against Aoide's own CONTRACTS.md (C:\Users\dxcen\Projects\Aoide\CONTRACTS.md, read-only, docs only) and say which section you used. If aoide's precedence differs, follow aoide and say so.
  - --aoide-daemon-events <PATH>: absolute only. The default is $AOIDE_DAEMON_EVENTS from the perch's own environment when it is absolute, else $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/aoide/events.jsonl. This mirrors how mesh's default_socket() reads XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.
  - One resolver function per path. The mesh view and the runner both use it, so they can never disagree.
- The runner (perch/src/aoide) passes AOIDE_AUDIT_LOG ONLY when --aoide-audit-log was given explicitly. It never passes the daemon feed path to any call.
- GET /hub/mesh/events?audit=N&daemon=M:
  - Each cursor is optional and digits only. Any other key, a repeat or a non-digit gets 400.
  - The answer is {events:[{stream:"audit"|"daemon", event:{...}}], next:{audit,daemon}, reset:{audit,daemon}, files:{audit, daemon}}.
  - The event object is passed through unchanged inside `event`. It already has its own `source` field, so never overwrite it.
  - files shows each path tilde-abbreviated (the existing tilde()), or null when that stream has no usable path.
  - Read at most 64 KiB per file per call. A file shorter than its cursor is a reset to 0 (the feed is 1 MiB truncate-in-place). A missing file is an empty stream.
  - Merge order: by ts, then stream (audit first), then file order. Stable.
- Daemon feed filter: keep the existing CLASSES filter (audit, gate). secret and notification records are never forwarded.
- Audit log filter:
  - Find the record shape of aoide's audit log in CONTRACTS.md and the Aoide wiki (docs/Aoide-Wiki), docs only.
  - Forward only an allowlist of record kinds and fields that carry no secret value or name, no message body or subject, no SAS, pubkey, nonce, commitment or token.
  - When the shape is unclear, drop the record and say so in the README.
  - Never parse or forward argv or env captured in a record unless you show it is safe.
- Files are opened as today: rawfile::open_regular, O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK, regular file only, under a cap. A link or a FIFO is not read. Nothing is ever written to either file by the perch.
Page (webui/term/mesh):
- view.js reads the new shape and keeps one cursor per stream.
- Each line shows a small source label: `audit` or `daemon`. The label is plain text, never markup from the record.
- The empty-state sentence names both files from `files`, or says which stream has no path.
- Polls stay as W4 made them: lane.js, every 5 s, none while the tab is hidden.
permissions_granted_by_orchestrator: perch/src/main.rs: the two flags, removing --aoide-events, and its parse test
perch/src/serve.rs: ONLY the test Options literal that sets aoide_events (about line 1443)
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48131 with temp --aoide-home and both flags pointed at temp files. Append lines to each file and curl /hub/mesh/events with cursors. Then --stop. List the browser-pane steps for the orchestrator: the mesh tab shows both labels and polls every 5 s.
risk: Read-only tails of two files another program writes. The privacy risk is forwarding a secret, a message or key material from the audit log: the allowlist must fail closed. The default daemon path is the operator's real runtime dir in production, which is intended, but it must never be read by a test.
